definitions.explanation: A printed proof of purchase given at the time of a transaction.

examples.japanese: レシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦おく→置く：01092_oku⟧。
⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧レシート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: A receipt is required for returns.

notes:
レシート is a loanword from English "receipt," referring to the printed slip given at checkout.

KEY DISTINCTION:
- レシート: cash register receipt (printed automatically)
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧: formal receipt (handwritten or stamped, for business expenses and tax deductions)

You may need to specifically request a ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧ at the register if you need one for business purposes. Cashiers typically ask レシート⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{要|い}ります→要る：09589_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Do you need a receipt?).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to keep the receipt
- レシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away the receipt
- レシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the receipt
- レシート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get a receipt
